states.DEGRADED: new risk-increasing operations may be restricted; safe exits/refunds should remain available
states.HALTED: new value-risking operations fail closed; withdrawals/refunds/recovery may remain available only when explicitly classified safe
states.RECOVERY: only explicitly authorized recovery and safe-exit operations may proceed

action_classes.SAFE_WHEN_PAUSED: may run when component is paused if system safety allows
action_classes.WITHDRAWAL_ONLY: value-reducing/user-exit action designed to remain available when safe
action_classes.RECOVERY_ONLY: may run only as part of authorized recovery
